items.title: Reduce operational overhead by migrating from AWS CloudHSM to AWS KMS
items.summary: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) supports the security certifications, algorithms, and performance that most AWS CloudHSM workloads require. Organizations that migrate from AWS CloudHSM to AWS KMS have significantly reduced costs while eliminating hardware security module (HSM) provisioning, patching, and high-availability management.
